verdict.rationale: Claude Code is itself an agent, but first-party docs explicitly document a server mode. `claude mcp serve` starts Claude Code as a stdio MCP server that other applications can connect to, which makes this axis applicable and delivered. Client-side MCP connection evidence (`claude mcp add`, connecting to external servers) is not credited here. Missing for 10: details on which tools are exposed and how clients configure the connection, any non-stdio (HTTP/remote) server transport, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the server mode.
